title: Passage 5
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: One of the great things about travelling alone is that you make the rules about where you go and what you eat.
sentences.cn: 独自旅行的一大妙处在于，你可以自己做决定要去哪里以及吃什么。

sentences.en: Travelling alone really shows you what you're made of and helps you to discover inner strength you didn't know you had.
sentences.cn: 独自旅行能真正地展现出你是什么样的人，并帮助你发掘你所拥有的自己未知的内在力量。

sentences.en: Besides, it also gives you time to think and learn.
sentences.cn: 此外，它还能给你思考和学习的时间。

sentences.en: When your eyes are wide open, you'll get a whole new outlook on the world.
sentences.cn: 当你的眼界更开阔时，你会对这个世界有一个全新的认识。

sentences.en: It's easy to think that travelling alone is lonely.
sentences.cn: 人们很容易认为独自旅行会很孤独。

sentences.en: Although that may sometimes be true, you're hardly ever alone.
sentences.cn: 虽然有时确实如此，但其实你几乎从来都不是独自一人。

sentences.en: When you travel in a one-person team,
sentences.cn: 当你独自旅行时，

sentences.en: this can provide a chance for you to enjoy the most interesting part of travel,
sentences.cn: 这会让你有机会享受旅行中最有趣的部分，

sentences.en: communicating with the locals and meeting travellers from all corners of the world.
sentences.cn: 那就是与当地人交流，以及结识来自世界各地的旅行者。

sentences.en: In fact, travelling is not easy.
sentences.cn: 事实上，旅行并不容易。

sentences.en: There's research to be done, flights to be booked and choices to be made.
sentences.cn: 要做攻略、订机票、做选择。

sentences.en: Not to mention that things can, and often do, go wrong.
sentences.cn: 更不用提旅行中很多事可能（也确实经常）会出错。

sentences.en: One of the main advantages of travelling with friends is being able to share these things,
sentences.cn: 与朋友一起旅行的主要优点之一，就是能够共同面对这些事情，

sentences.en: and support each other through the process,
sentences.cn: 并在整个过程中相互支持，

sentences.en: even if it's just someone who will wait with your bag when you go to the bathroom.
sentences.cn: 哪怕只是在你去洗手间时，有人帮你看着包等你。

sentences.en: It's true that travelling with others can give you a sense of safety, especially if you're new to travel.
sentences.cn: 与他人结伴旅行确实能给你带来安全感，尤其是如果你是旅行新手的话。

sentences.en: You know that if you get lost or have your wallet stolen,
sentences.cn: 你知道，如果你迷路了，或者钱包被偷了，

sentences.en: there's someone to hold your hand when you try to explain your situation in a foreign police station.
sentences.cn: 当你在异国的警察局试着说明自己的情况时，会有人握着你的手支持你。

sentences.en: There's no right or wrong way to travel.
sentences.cn: 旅行的方式没有对错之分。

sentences.en: Whether you travel alone or team up with friends, it depends on yourself.
sentences.cn: 不管是独自旅行还是与朋友结伴旅行，都取决于你自己。
